info.title: Z-RIDE local prototype REST API
info.description: Implemented server-owned mission/motion/cabin state, world/storage/observer and 4D effect-intent contract, checked 2026-11-01. CLI uses a single-instance SQLite checkpoint (format 2, imports legacy format 1); programmatic createDemoServer() stays ephemeral unless dbPath/stateStore is configured. Closed demo, not production vehicle authentication. REST only; game /ws and read-only /observer/ws are documented separately. Location and cabin reports are client claims, never hardware attested. Example credentials/IDs are synthetic placeholders. Phone web account integration is served at /play (2026-11-04): GIS JavaScript popup, nonce-bound ID token exchange and guest/QR participation; no OAuth redirect endpoint. Checkpoint format 2 accepts legacy format 1. /play/demo and /play/vehicle are functional vehicle/phone API mocks with manual approval and local QR rendering, not new REST APIs or actual vehicle SDK execution.

servers.description: Android Emulator route to PC loopback, not a physical-phone address
Shared team demo; private enrollment/observer keys. HTTP is not encrypted.

get.description: Public process health only; room counts and room identities are not exposed. A failed durable write poisons this process: 503 with ok=false until database access is restored and the server restarts. Does not attest app/GPS/vehicle connectivity.

503.description: Durable storage failed; database recovery and restart required

post.description: Guest enrollment, not device attestation. When ZRIDE_TEST_ACCESS_KEY (programmatic testAccessKey) is configured, body.accessKey must match or 401 TEST_ACCESS_REQUIRED is returned. No per-user account, refresh, logout or device attestation. Limit 500 retained sessions; expired entries are not automatically removed. Unknown request keys are ignored. The shared test key is never returned or stored in durable game state; subsequent APIs use the newly issued Bearer token.

503.description: 500 retained guest sessions reached; or durable storage unavailable

error.message: Durable state is unavailable; restart after restoring database access

post.summary: Create a host room or refresh its single-use code
post.description: CAR_HOST only. Optional bounded JSON object body is consumed before responding; empty body means an empty object. Valid fields are ignored. Malformed/non-object JSON returns 400; more than 16 KiB returns 413. Reuse the existing host token to keep room/members/state and rotate the code. New code has 120-second TTL and permits one join; refresh separately for each next phone. Old code is invalidated. Creating another host session creates another room.

post.summary: Validate reported proximity and add one shared supply
post.description: Approved PHONE passenger only; independent of the parked battle gate. Server checks UTC schedule/version, 80m distance, accuracy >0 and <=50m, reported age 0..10000ms. One reward per member+spawn+UTC day. Same commandId with canonical-equivalent JSON replays; a changed body conflicts. Only successful claims retain receipts. HTTP claim and WS command IDs use separate receipt stores. Success increments supplies and broadcasts snapshot before HTTP response may arrive; no raw phone coordinates/individual spawn ID in shared snapshot. POST only (other methods: 405).

A storage-poisoned process returns 503 before reading uncommitted in-memory state.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque token returned by POST /api/session. Header must be Authorization: Bearer <token>; the current implementation checks the exact Bearer prefix. Never put credentials in URLs.

observerOperatorAuth.description: Separate read-only deployment key ZRIDE_OBSERVER_TOKEN, not a game session token. Disabled by default; never put it in URL, browser storage or logs.

placeReviewerAuth.description: Independent reviewer credential; observer key is read-only and cannot review.

phoneAccountAuth.description: Opaque accountToken from guest/Google exchange. Separate purpose from CAR_HOST/PHONE gameplay tokens. Cannot authenticate game WS or send vehicle telemetry.

EpochMillis.description: UTC Unix milliseconds; not ISO text or seconds.

accessKey.description: Required at runtime when ZRIDE_TEST_ACCESS_KEY is configured. Shared team test enrollment key, supplied privately. Keep out of URLs, logs, browser persistent storage and source code. Distinct from read-only observer key.

SessionRequest.description: Guest demo enrollment, not account login or trusted vehicle authentication. Nickname is not trimmed. accessKey is conditionally required by deployment configuration.

token.description: Opaque 24-random-byte base64url Bearer credential. Keep secret.

joinCode.description: Case-insensitive; use the current host code without whitespace.

allowManualUnknown.description: Only explicit true plus current UNKNOWN observation releases a prior EMPTY lock. Does not prove occupancy or identity.

ApproveRequest.description: Seat omitted/null keeps the requested seat. Only the room host can approve or reassign.

Sector.description: Inclusive [min,max], vehicle-relative degrees: 0 front, +90 right, -90 left, +/-180 rear.

Charge.description: Display-only client-reported strings; not charging attestation and not the battle gate.

supportDamage.description: Inactive initial value 2 is legacy state, not free support. Successful support consumes one supply and sets damage 3.

LastCollect.description: mode/validationTier appear on world claims only; individual world spawn ID and phone coordinates are not broadcast.

collectedPickupIds.description: Party-wide collected demo fixture IDs; all party members must hide/disable them.

Collection.description: Snapshot retains the original DEMO_PICKUP mode label even after a world claim. Use claim.validationTier/lastCollect.mode for the world path; do not infer GPS trust from this label.

RoomSnapshot.description: Viewer-specific projection. Pending phone sees only itself and redacted vehicle/stats/enemies. Approved phones do not see pending members or host joinCode. Never merge projections across credentials.

Coordinate.description: Named WGS84 degrees; latitude then longitude. JSON does not allow NaN/Infinity.

includeClaimed.description: History/debug only. Default omits party pickups during cooldown.

NearbyRequest.description: Map browsing centre; not a physical visit proof. radiusM omitted/null uses 500 in the prototype; send a number when present.

PhoneLocation.description: Client-reported fix, not hardware attestation. measuredAgeMs is measured on the phone monotonic clock, not an absolute timestamp. EMULATOR_GPS/MOCK or isMock=true always yields MOCK_DEMO.

spawnCycleId.description: Copy from latest nearby. Rejects a delayed request from an earlier respawn cycle.

ClaimRequest.description: Use the values from nearby. Retries must preserve commandId and the entire JSON value, including measuredAgeMs. Refreshing a fix requires a new commandId. Unknown extra keys are tolerated but participate in the idempotency fingerprint.

respawnAt.description: Server Unix ms deadline, null before first claim.

version.description: World version at the original receipt, including replay of a pre-upgrade successful command.

ClaimReceipt.description: inventory is the historical value when the original claim committed, including on replay. Fetch GET room or use a newer WS stateVersion for current inventory. No currentInventory/stateVersion field exists in this HTTP receipt.

EffectSessionRequest.description: CAR_HOST only. enabled=true additionally requires explicit locallyEnabled=true and nonempty supported channels from the current vehicle client. Enabling requires an authenticated current host socket, fresh P/UX/foreground gate and PLAYING. enabled=false is permitted to stop without the battle gate. Enabling must bind vehicleConnectionId from the current CAR_HOST auth.ok and expectedControlVersion from the latest GET effects.controlVersion. This rejects a delayed first delivery after a newer stop or opt-in. Known same-scope idempotent retry is checked before control-version comparison.

EffectSceneRequest.description: Virtual game speed, never real road speed. AIRFLOW intensity=min(virtualSpeedMps/30,1)*session.maxIntensity01. Scene updates do not command a physical fan stage.

EffectSummary.description: Ephemeral state only. Never execute active entries as hardware instructions. Only fresh vehicle.effect.intent on the current CAR_HOST socket can authorize local mapping. Pause, gate loss, socket replacement/disconnect and server restart invalidate the session; individual TTL expiration stops that channel, not the opt-in session.

EffectMutationResponse.description: effects is the current projection. data may contain historical logical result/intents on idempotent retry and must never be used as an actuator execution channel. replayed=true emits no new WS effects.

VehicleEffectReport.description: Only the actual current CAR_HOST game WebSocket can report execution status. APPLIED_CONFIRMED means client-reported get/callback confirmation, not server hardware attestation. Expired/stopped/old-session reports are rejected.

VehicleEffectIntent.description: Current native host WebSocket only. Semantic channel/cue/intensity, never raw vehicle property writes. Server delivery is not evidence of SDK execution. Native clients must enforce local UX/P/foreground, supported capability and user settings.

expectedInstanceId.description: null only if shared.instance is null. Otherwise copy the current instanceId.

accountToken.description: Opaque PHONE_ACCOUNT bearer. Never a Google token or a game/vehicle token.

credential.description: Google ID token with the server-issued nonce; not an access token/email/subject.

x-prototype-limits.storage: Single-instance durable SQLite checkpoint when dbPath/stateStore is configured (CLI defaults to data/zride.sqlite); programmatic no-store mode is ephemeral. No automatic claim/receipt retention cleanup.

x-not-implemented: hardware GPS or passenger identity attestation
native client execution of 4D HVAC/light settings and physical application/restore verification
seatbelt gameplay and seat-specific audio actuator control

x-persistence.transaction: Commit reward and receipt together before success response/broadcast
x-persistence.restore: Socket null; vehicle UNKNOWN, foreground false and lease invalid; PLAYING becomes PAUSED with new epoch; fresh report and explicit host start required
x-persistence.vehicleEffects: Effect sessions, physical intents, execution reports and effect replay receipts are ephemeral and never restored. Durable game state does not authorize actuator replay.

firstMessage.token: operator key OR own room CAR_HOST token

x-vehicle-effects-websocket.executionRule: Never execute HTTP data.intents, GET state, room/observer snapshots or retried receipts. Only a fresh matching nonexpired WS intent may be mapped locally to supported SDK calls.
x-vehicle-effects-websocket.physicalVerification: APPLIED_CONFIRMED is client-reported get/callback observation, not hardware attestation.

x-cabin-websocket.meaning: Client-reported SDK/quality observation; no hardware attestation; never creates arbitrary physical setter calls
x-cabin-websocket.state: ephemeral; same sampleSeq never refreshes observation freshness

x-deployment.cors: Exact configured HTTP(S) origins; GET/POST JSON/Bearer preflights only; no credentialed cookies. OPTIONS is transport metadata, not a new business route.
x-deployment.forwarding: Explicit trusted direct peer IPs only; walk X-Forwarded-For right to left.
x-deployment.phoneConfig: /play/config.js or tools/export-phone.mjs supplies public API origin; QR uses ZRIDE_PHONE_PUBLIC_URL.
x-deployment.limits: 100 game WebSockets and 500 sessions per process. HTTP IP: 120/10s; world: 30/10s/session; WS: 120/10s/session. Capacities are configured ceilings, not performance guarantees.

x-collection-websocket.rule: Approved party members invalidate nearby caches on event/snapshot.collection.revision. Fetch nearby again. No raw GPS or spawn coordinates in event. Respawn emits one invalidation after the stored server deadline. Default cooldown 300000 ms.

x-mission-websocket.delivery: Post-commit invalidation hint. Deduplicate by revision/resultId; reconnect reads snapshot and REST. Physical effects are never replayed.

x-phone-accounts.policy: One active vehicle participation; historical memberships retained. A confirmed switch only moves participation after target HOST approval. No party inventory transfer.
x-phone-accounts.configuration: GAME_DISPLAY_NAME/GAME_PUBLIC_ORIGIN/GAME_PHONE_JOIN_URL/GAME_BROWSER_API_ORIGIN/GAME_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Existing ZRIDE settings remain fallback aliases.
x-phone-accounts.google: Disabled without client ID and HTTPS. Official Google library verifies signature/issuer/audience/expiry; server checks iat/nonce and consumes persisted challenges. LINK preserves guest userId; existing identity conflicts never merge by email.
x-phone-accounts.storage: Format 2 imports legacy format1. Older releases reject format2 to prevent silently dropping account records. Backup is required for downgrade.
